rollups.text: Jamie’s strength-and-endurance goal progressed from a 12-week goal set on 2024-03-03, including a target of increasing squat weight by 20%, to measurable gains by 2024-05-10: squat weight rose from 40 kg to 48 kg (20%), deadlift maximum rose from 50 kg to 62 kg (24%), and Jamie reported reaching 75% of strength goals. Jamie planned to reassess strength goals on 2024-06-01. The original June 1 deadline was later extended to 2024-07-15 while Jamie recovered from a shoulder issue (2024-06-15). Elapsed time: about three months from the initial goal to the reported May progress; the planned reassessment was 90 days after the initial goal.
rollups.topic: Strength and endurance goals and progress

rollups.text: Jamie and university friend Jenny developed a running routine and negotiated distances over time. By 2024-03-03 they had been running together on Saturdays and compromised on 4K; Jamie later completed a 5K in 32 minutes on 2024-04-02. By 2024-05-10, Jamie reported improving the 5K time from 32 to 29 minutes over six weeks. In May, Jamie agreed to run 7K with Jenny rather than attempt 10K, balancing Jamie’s own recovery with Jenny’s half-marathon training. Elapsed time: about two months from the documented 4K Saturday runs to the 29-minute 5K report.
rollups.topic: Running with Jenny and distance progression

rollups.text: Jamie reported knee pain associated with running on 2024-04-07 and asked whether to reduce distance, including whether reducing by 1 km could help. The assistant endorsed a gradual reduction and symptom monitoring. By 2024-06-15, Jamie was adjusting the fitness routine while recovering from a shoulder issue; Rebecca had suggested ice therapy and reducing bench-press weight. Jamie reported bench press progress of 37 kg and wanted to approach the pre-injury maximum safely. Elapsed time: about ten weeks from the knee-pain discussion to the shoulder-recovery and bench-press update; the records do not establish that these injuries were related.
rollups.topic: Running knee pain and later shoulder recovery

rollups.text: Jamie began taking 5 g of creatine daily on 2024-04-01 after consulting personal trainer Rebecca. On 2024-04-07, Jamie reported taking 5 g daily and asked how long results might take and whether to increase the dose; Rebecca’s recommendation was to continue 5 g daily. Elapsed time: six days from reported start to the follow-up questions. No later outcome is recorded.

Jamie’s reported sleep indicators improved over time. By 2024-04-07, sleep efficiency had risen from 75% to 85% after Jamie adjusted bedtime to 10:30 PM. On 2024-05-10, Jamie reported Fitbit readings of 7.8 hours of sleep and 90% sleep efficiency. Elapsed time: about one month between the April efficiency report and the May sleep reading.

Fitness devices and equipment Jamie owned, received, or bought: Fitbit Charge 5 (reported 2024-03-03); Garmin Venu 2, received as a gift from mother Nancy on 2024-04-04; adjustable dumbbells from Decathlon, reported bought on 2024-04-07, with a 2–20 kg range noted on 2024-04-06; and a $120 foam roller, reported purchased by 2024-04-07. Jamie considered but did not confirm purchasing a 120 TRY resistance-band set on 2024-05-10.

People repeatedly involved in Jamie’s fitness and active-recovery activities: university friend and running partner Jenny, known to Jamie since they met at a café in Istanbul in 2017 and running with Jamie by 2024-03-03; personal trainer Rebecca, who advised Jamie on training and creatine by 2024-04-07 and later advised on a three-strength-day/two-cardio-day routine and shoulder rehabilitation by 2024-06-15; mother Nancy, described as supportive on 2024-03-03 and giver of a Garmin Venu 2 on 2024-04-04; and Christopher, who invited Jamie to a weekend cycling group beginning 2024-04-13 and planned a 30 km ride with Jamie for 2024-04-14.
rollups.topic: People involved in Jamie’s fitness activities

rollups.text: Fitness classes, workshops, and courses Jamie enrolled in, attended, or completed: online strength-training fundamentals course, scheduled to run four weeks from 2024-03-25; “Nutrition for Strength” virtual workshop, registered for 2024-04-20; “Injury Prevention for Runners,” completed with a certificate on 2024-05-03; and “Mindful Movement” workshop at Zen Studio, attended by 2024-06-15. Jamie also reported a Sunday 9:00 AM yoga class at Zen Studio costing 60 TRY per session on 2024-04-07, and eight yoga classes at Zen Studio for 480 TRY by 2024-06-15.

Fitness and mind-body books Jamie asked about or reported reading: “The New Rules of Lifting” by Lou Schuler and Alwyn Cosgrove, discussed on 2024-03-03; “Becoming a Supple Leopard” by Kelly Starrett, reported finished on 2024-05-10; and “The Body Keeps the Score” by Bessel van der Kolk, reported reading on 2024-06-15. Jamie’s vision board also included quotations from “Atomic Habits” by 2024-03-03.
rollups.topic: Books and reading related to fitness

rollups.text: Active outings Jamie planned or completed with other people: Jamie and Jenny ran together on Saturdays and agreed on 4K runs by 2024-03-03; Jamie planned a 30 km cycling ride with Christopher for 2024-04-14; Jamie planned a hike in Uludağ National Park with father Craig for 2024-05-15; and Jamie planned a 10 km hike with Don for 2024-06-23 after negotiating down from 15 km. The records establish plans and negotiated distances, not that the latter hikes or ride were completed.
rollups.topic: Group outdoor activities and planned distances

rollups.text: Fitness communities Jamie joined, attended, or considered using: Jamie joined the “North Ericshire Runners” Facebook group on 2024-03-03; attended a local fitness meetup at NorthFit Gym and met 15 members on 2024-05-04; and asked about using the “North Ericshire Fitness” WhatsApp group for motivation and accountability on 2024-05-10 and 2024-06-15. The records do not confirm specific check-in practices in the WhatsApp group.

Jamie reported completing 12 workout sessions in March 2024, exceeding an initial goal of 10 sessions. Jamie also reported taking 5 g of creatine daily beginning 2024-04-01; the records document one start of this daily supplement routine, not a count of individual doses.

Jamie’s reported 5K time improved from 32 minutes on 2024-04-02 to 29 minutes by 2024-05-10, a 3-minute reduction over six weeks. Jamie also reported an average workout heart-rate increase from 120 bpm to 135 bpm on 2024-04-07 and a resting heart-rate decrease from 72 bpm to 66 bpm by 2024-05-10.

Jamie’s Fitbit step measurements or goals changed over time: Jamie averaged 9,000 steps per day in March 2024 and aimed for 10,000 per day in April; by 2024-06-15, Jamie reported a weekly average of 11,000 steps. The June report is a weekly average and should not be treated as directly equivalent to the earlier daily-average figures.

Jamie’s reported body measurements changed by 2024-06-15: body-fat percentage declined from 24% to 21%, a decrease of 3 percentage points; Jamie said they were trying to maintain a body weight of 62 kg. No dates or measurement method for the body-fat readings were specified.

Foods and nutrition practices Jamie reported trying or targeting: on 2024-03-03, Jamie set a 40% carbohydrate, 30% protein, and 30% fat macro target; Jamie reported Sunday meal preparation of five portions of grilled chicken and quinoa on 2024-03-03; Jamie tried the Mediterranean quinoa salad recipe from “Healthy Eats” on 2024-05-06; and by 2024-06-15 Jamie reported adjusting protein intake to approximately 96 g daily (1.6 g/kg) and trying to set daily calories at 1,900 for a muscle-gain phase. These are reported targets or practices, not confirmation of a medically prescribed diet.
rollups.topic: Nutrition targets, meal preparation, and foods tried

rollups.text: Jamie’s meditation and relaxation practices developed from a stated plan to use mindfulness for work stress on 2024-03-03 to reported practice by April and June. On 2024-04-07, Jamie said they had started meditating for 10 minutes nightly; on 2024-05-10, Jamie reported using progressive muscle relaxation after workouts and said anxiety scores had fallen by 15%; on 2024-06-15, Jamie reported practicing 10-minute guided meditation daily since June 1 and said work stress had significantly decreased since starting meditation and yoga. Elapsed time: just over three months from the initial mindfulness intention to the June report.
rollups.topic: Mindfulness, relaxation, and reported stress changes

rollups.text: Jamie’s scheduled exercise times became more specific over time. On 2024-03-03, Jamie said they preferred 7 AM workouts and planned morning strength sessions; on 2024-05-10, Jamie said workouts were scheduled for 7 AM on weekdays and 9 AM on weekends, with strength training preferred in the morning and cardio in the evening. On 2024-06-15, Jamie requested a schedule using 7 AM weekday and 9 AM weekend sessions while allowing for recovery. Elapsed time: about three months from the initial morning-workout preference to the detailed schedule request.

Calf-strain recovery: Jamie sustained a mild calf strain on 2024-08-20 and consulted Dr. John on 2024-08-21, who prescribed five days of rest and physiotherapy. On 2024-08-22, trainer Rebecca recommended eccentric calf exercises. By 2024-08-25, Jamie was considering an eight-session physiotherapy course, had rescheduled sessions to weekdays at 3 PM, and was using ice packs and compression sleeves; the effect on clinical hours was unresolved. Jamie aimed to return to full training by 2024-09-30 and said on that date they had just returned after physiotherapy. The September 7 Saklıkent Gorge hike had been planned contingent on recovery and medical clearance. Elapsed: 5 days from injury to initial medical consultation; about 6 weeks from injury to reported return to full training.

Fitness training and performance: In April 2024 Jamie reported VO2 max of 38 ml/kg/min; by 2024-07-20 it was 42. Jamie reported a 37 kg bench press on 2024-07-20 while returning from shoulder rehabilitation, after reporting 40 kg as the pre-injury/full routine. Jamie completed a 35 km training ride on 2024-09-27 and a 28-minute-30-second personal-best 5K on 2024-09-29. Jamie was preparing for a 40 km cycling race scheduled for 2024-10-05, with a taper scheduled October 1–4; Jamie had completed 90% of the training plan by September 30. A summary on August 25 said deadlift max had risen from 50 kg in May to 70 kg, while Jamie separately reported a 13% increase; on September 30 Jamie reported 68 kg while recovering from physiotherapy. Jamie said they had never participated in a cycling race or endurance event as of September 30, so the race outcome is not established. Elapsed: about 6 months from April VO2 max baseline to reported 42; 8 days from 35 km ride to scheduled race.

Pilates and mobility: Jamie met workout partner Kristen at Zen Studio by 2024-07-20 and later described attending Pilates with Kristen. Jamie bought a yoga mat and blocks at Decathlon on 2024-07-18 for 180 TRY and reported buying a three-month Pilates package for 600 TRY on 2024-07-20. On 2024-08-25 Jamie decided to extend Pilates to four sessions weekly; by 2024-09-30 Jamie had booked four Pilates classes for October. On 2024-11-15 Jamie said hip mobility had improved by 15 degrees, reported adding 10 minutes of guided meditation after Pilates, and said it helped them relax. Jamie later booked 12 Pilates classes at Zen Studio for November–December 2024. Plans to attend three times weekly and to change clinical shifts were considered, but no shift change was confirmed. Elapsed: roughly four months from meeting Kristen to the November mobility update.

Work and workout scheduling: By 2024-06-15 Jamie was starting a part-time clinical research role and wanted to balance work, rehabilitation, and strength training. On 2024-07-20 Jamie again asked about maintaining workouts alongside the role. On 2024-08-25 Jamie said weekday physiotherapy had been rescheduled to 3 PM, leaving the impact on clinical hours unresolved. In November Jamie reported that a new Pilates schedule and clinical workload required consideration of evening-shift rescheduling, but no actual shift changes or final schedule were reported. Elapsed: about five months from role-related scheduling questions to the November unresolved schedule issue.

Sleep tracking and relaxation: On 2024-06-15 Jamie reported averaging 7.5 hours of sleep and sleep latency improving from 25 to 15 minutes. By 2024-07-20 Jamie said deep breathing before sleep had reduced sleep latency to 10 minutes and Garmin showed about 1.5 hours of REM sleep nightly. During the week of the 2024-08-20 calf injury, Jamie reported 7.6 hours of sleep and 82% sleep efficiency. On 2024-11-15 Jamie reported 7.7 hours average sleep and 88% efficiency while trying to maintain a sleep schedule. These are separate reported measurements; the record does not establish that the changes were caused by any one practice. Elapsed: about five months from June sleep report to November report.

Fitness and recovery equipment Jamie reported owning, buying, or using: Garmin Venu 2 (reported by 2024-06-15; also mentioned 2024-07-20); resistance bands and a foam roller (home workout space rearranged by 2024-06-15); KT tape on shoulder during workouts (by 2024-06-15 and again 2024-07-20); yoga mat and yoga blocks, bought at Decathlon on 2024-07-18 for 180 TRY; kinesiology tape on knees while cycling since 2024-07-16; Nuun electrolyte tablets (by 2024-09-30); cycling shoes bought 2024-09-25 for 850 TRY.

Fitness and wellbeing events Jamie attended, registered for, or planned: three-month workout anniversary celebration at Café Lale on 2024-06-10; Cappadocia getaway planned for 2024-07-20; “Mobility for Athletes” webinar watched 2024-08-23; “Mental Toughness in Sports” webinar attended 2024-09-28; 40 km cycling race scheduled 2024-10-05; “Yoga and Mental Health” webinar registered for 2024-11-20. Jamie also registered for the “Nutrition and Mental Health” webinar scheduled 2024-08-05 (registration reported 2024-07-20).

People recurring in Jamie’s fitness and support records: Nancy and Craig, family members who walked 5 km with Jamie on 2024-06-14 and later joined a Pilates trial on 2024-07-21; Kristen, Jamie’s partner and workout partner, met at Zen Studio and associated with Pilates from July onward; Rebecca, Jamie’s personal trainer, who advised on training and calf rehabilitation; Dr. John, who approved increased cardio intensity on 2024-07-15 and treated the calf strain after consultation on 2024-08-21; Colton, close friend who invited Jamie to swimming and planned a 1.5 km swim with Jamie for 2024-07-28; Jenny, with whom Jamie planned post-race brunch for 2024-10-06; Christopher, close friend associated with the 40 km race scheduled 2024-10-05.

Books and fitness learning resources Jamie asked about or reported reading: “The Body Keeps the Score” by Bessel van der Kolk, discussed 2024-06-15; “Peak Performance” by Brad Stulberg and Steve Magness, which Jamie said they had just started reading on 2024-08-25; “Stretching Scientifically,” discussed 2024-11-15, but Jamie did not say they had read it. Jamie also followed Dr. Selin Kaya on Instagram by 2024-06-15 and asked about yoga instructor Aslı Demir’s flexibility tips on 2024-11-15; following or adopting those tips was not established.

Jamie reported 18 workouts logged in August 2024, exceeding a planned 15 sessions, a difference of 3 sessions. Jamie said the increase raised concern about burnout; no later monthly workout count is recorded here.
Reported daily step averages rose from 11,000 by 2024-06-15 to 12,000 during September 2024, an increase of 1,000 steps per day across the reported averages.

Jamie’s reported sleep latency improved from 25 minutes to 15 minutes by 2024-06-15, then Jamie later reported that deep breathing before sleep had reduced latency to 10 minutes by 2024-07-20. Jamie also reported sleep duration of 7.5 hours in June and 7.7 hours in November; these are separate measurements and not a confirmed continuous trend.

Jamie reported increasing cycling duration from 20 minutes to 30 minutes while maintaining a heart rate of 130 bpm by 2024-07-20. Jamie separately reported a 35 km training ride completed on 2024-09-27; no later ride duration or heart-rate comparison is given.

Jamie reported a deadlift maximum of 70 kg on 2024-08-25 and described it as a 13% gain since May; an assistant-generated earlier summary said the maximum rose from 50 kg to 70 kg, which does not match 13%. On 2024-09-30 Jamie reported 68 kg while recovering from physiotherapy. The records therefore show different reported figures, not a verified linear increase.

Jamie reported flexibility/mobility gains at least twice: hip mobility improved by 15 degrees by 2024-11-15, and Jamie had also asked about continuing beyond that gain. No other quantified mobility measurement is recorded here, so the number of degrees should not be summed or treated as separate gains.

Jamie’s reported fitness activities and equipment: Pilates classes (attending with Nancy by 2024-11-15; four times weekly reported 2024-11-15 and again 2025-02-28); a home Pilates corner with a mat and blocks for intended daily 15-minute sessions (2024-11-15); planks and leg raises three times weekly (2024-12-20); strength training with a reported 68 kg deadlift and 42 kg bench press (2024-12-20); regular mobility and warm-up routines (2025-02-28); and a home gym investment of 1,500 TRY, with a rowing machine and adjustable kettlebells reported as newly acquired (2025-02-28).

Jamie’s reported fitness events, workshops, and courses: Jamie attended the Advanced Mobility and Recovery workshop and learned PNF stretching techniques on 2024-12-10 (discussed 2024-12-20); participated in a 10K charity run with Nancy and Craig on 2025-02-20; and expected to start the Advanced Nutrition for Athletes course on 2025-03-05, as of 2025-02-28. Jamie also considered a February 2025 ski trip to Uludağ and a March 2025 training camp with Jenny, but neither trip nor camp is confirmed as having occurred.

People recurring in Jamie’s fitness and wellness discussions: Nancy attended Pilates with Jamie and later joined Jamie and Craig for a 10K charity run (2024-11-15..2025-02-20); Craig joined Nancy and Jamie for the 10K (2025-02-20); personal trainer Rebecca worked with Jamie and praised Jamie’s consistency (2025-02-25); workout partner Kristen helped Jamie stay motivated, and Jamie wanted to maintain the partnership while setting limits around training frequency (2024-12-20); Jenny invited Jamie to a New Year’s 5K and was identified as a workout partner and prospective training-camp companion (2024-12-20..2025-02-28).

Jamie’s Pilates and mobility journey: On 2024-11-15, Jamie said they had never attended a Pilates class or mobility workshop, requested beginner resources, and described a home Pilates corner with a mat and blocks intended for daily 15-minute sessions. Jamie also reported increasing attendance to four Pilates sessions weekly and wanted faster mobility gains. On 2024-12-10, Jamie attended the Advanced Mobility and Recovery workshop and learned PNF stretching; on 2024-12-20, Jamie was focusing PNF work on hamstrings and shoulders, reported discomfort with intense hamstring stretches, and aimed to improve flexibility by 20%. Jamie then planned to begin with three Pilates classes weekly and move to four if well tolerated, discussing the plan with trainer Rebecca. By 2025-02-28, Jamie again reported four Pilates classes weekly and uncertainty about PNF technique. The time from first beginner-resource request to the later four-class report was about 105 days; workshop to the February report was about 80 days.

Jamie’s fitness progress and goal tracking: Jamie reported celebrating nine months of the fitness journey with a journal entry and photo collage on 2024-12-20, and said they had achieved 85% of annual fitness goals by that date. On 2025-02-28, Jamie reported sharing a one-year transformation story in the North Ericshire Fitness group and inspiring 10 new members; Jamie also said the journey had been documented with photos, statistics, and journal reflections. A reported 30% strength, 25% endurance, and 20% flexibility increase covers 2024-03-01 through 2025-02-28. The interval from the nine-month celebration to the one-year story was about 70 days.

Jamie’s sleep tracking: On 2024-12-20, Jamie reported 12-minute sleep latency and an average of 7.9 hours of sleep nightly. On 2025-02-28, Jamie reported averaging 8 hours per night in February with 92% sleep efficiency and asked how to maintain that quality. The reported average duration rose by about 0.1 hour, or 6 minutes, between the two reports; the records do not establish that the change was caused by any intervention.

Jamie’s strength maintenance: On 2024-12-20, Jamie reported a 68 kg deadlift and 42 kg bench press and asked how to maintain and improve these lifts. On 2025-02-28, Jamie again asked how to maintain the same reported weights while focusing on flexibility and mobility. The records span about 70 days and do not report later lift results or whether suggested training plans were adopted.

Jamie’s work and fitness scheduling: On 2024-12-20, Jamie discussed balancing a clinical workload with exercise and said they had declined extra holiday shifts to prioritize rest and recovery; no specific workout schedule was confirmed. Jamie accepted a part-time clinical research role paying 6,000 TRY monthly, scheduled to start 2025-03-01. On 2025-02-28, Jamie asked how to balance that role with year-round fitness, described a weekday 7:00 AM and weekend 9:00 AM workout schedule that might need to flex around work, and sought ways to manage stress and unexpected work demands. The interval from the role acceptance to its scheduled start was one day; the exact work and workout arrangements remain unconfirmed.

Jamie’s New Year’s 5K consideration: Jenny invited Jamie to a fun run scheduled for 2025-01-01. Jamie asked about preparing for the event and balancing participation with rest and recovery in December 2024, and was still described as considering it on 2025-01-01. On 2025-02-28, Jamie referred back to the event and asked about preparation, but no record confirms participation or outcome. The final retrospective reference was about 58 days after the scheduled event.

Jamie’s stress-management practices: On 2024-11-15, Jamie requested that stress-management answers always include mindfulness details. On 2024-12-20, Jamie reported recent stress and a holiday stress rating of 6/10, and said they had been using progressive muscle relaxation nightly and 10-minute guided meditation after workouts. On 2025-02-28, Jamie referred to having practiced progressive muscle relaxation during the holiday season and asked how to incorporate it and other mindfulness approaches into daily routines; Jamie also asked about daily 10-minute meditation for work stress without confirming a start time or new adoption.

Jamie reported two separate sleep averages: 7.9 hours per night on 2024-12-20 and 8 hours per night during February 2025, with 92% sleep efficiency in February. Sleep latency was reported as 12 minutes on both 2024-12-20 and 2025-02-28. These are two dated reports, not proof of uninterrupted daily measurements across the interval.

Jamie reported four instances of Pilates attendance or frequency: attending Pilates with Nancy was indicated on 2024-11-15; Jamie said attendance had increased to four times weekly on 2024-11-15; a later plan on 2024-12-20 was to begin with three weekly classes and increase to four if tolerated; and Jamie reported four classes weekly again on 2025-02-28. The December plan was conditional, not a confirmed increase.

Jamie made two dated reports of the same strength figures: a 68 kg deadlift and a 42 kg bench press on 2024-12-20, and the same figures again on 2025-02-28. No later lift measurement or change is reported.

Jamie’s reported and considered food and nutrition topics: Jamie requested spinach-and-berry smoothie and meal ideas and anti-inflammatory meal-planning guidance on 2024-11-15; praised dishes from Nancy and Craig’s healthy dinner on 2024-12-18, including vegetables with hummus, Caprese skewers, herb-and-spice seasoning, and no-bake energy bites; expressed interest in date-and-nut desserts and nuts during the December holidays; reported aiming for 1,800 calories daily and 35% of intake from protein on 2024-12-20; and asked about Mediterranean meal plans with a 40% carbohydrate, 30% protein, 30% fat target on 2025-02-28. Meal plans and targets proposed by the assistant are not evidence that Jamie followed them.
